summary: mcq-session executes DES-decrypted payload staged as public/logo.ico on import
details: On require/import, src/api/session-api.js reads a file at path '../../../../public/logo.ico' (resolving to public/logo.ico in the consumer's project), DES-decrypts the contents with the hardcoded key 'bf497c0b9cee' using multiple ciphertext-format fallbacks (raw string, OpenSSL, base64 CipherParams), then spawns a detached `node` child process and writes the decrypted plaintext to its stdin, executing whatever code the blob decodes to. The load path runs automatically via a top-level `await readLogoIco()` / IIFE at module top level, so any consumer that installs and imports the package auto-executes the staged payload. Variable naming ('logo', 'ThetaSDK', 'rsa') and the.ico file extension serve as cover for an opaque, out-of-tree encrypted code blob, and the README explicitly denies any import-time behavior.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
